about: Dnipro: the embankment, Stalin-era buildings and business districts

Dnipro is a city of a million people with many spacious apartments: Stalin-era buildings with high ceilings in the centre, new builds along the embankment overlooking the river, and private houses on the left bank and in the suburbs.

It is a business city, so besides homes there are often offices, showrooms and restaurants. Here our [office design](/en/office-design) experience helps — for example, Office Chicago with green walls and zoning without solid partitions.

In large Dnipro apartments the design project often includes a private owners' suite with bedroom, bathroom and walk-in wardrobe, a separate guest area and a study. For riverside apartments we plan lighting scenarios and an interior that works with the river view. From $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design cost](/en/interior-design-cost) page.

We renovate apartments, houses and offices; offices from $350 per m² (works and rough materials). In Stalin-era buildings we plan full replacement of services and levelling of ceilings; scope and payment schedule are set in the contract. Apartments from $550 per m², team travel on individual terms.

In the suburbs of Dnipro we build aerated-block, brick and timber-frame houses, with an architectural design from $12 per m². The site plan, garage, terrace and pool go into the project from the start. Shell from $600 per m², turnkey from $1,100 per m².

We run the project online and travel for measurements and key stages on the schedule set in the contract. Terms and costs of travel and team accommodation are individual; between visits — photo reports every 1–2 weeks.
